nodes.description: Flat minimalist icon: crimson red office building with gold roof band, 3x3 grid of gold windows and a dark doorway, centered on a near-black navy background.

nodes.label: Brand Palette (Crimson, Gold, Dark Navy)
nodes.rationale: Dark background with high-contrast crimson/gold suggests a dark-themed app UI; likely matches manifest theme/background colors.

nodes.label: Office Building Symbol
nodes.rationale: Building glyph visually communicates the app's purpose of tracking office visits/attendance.

nodes.label: Google Calendar Two-way Sync (syncAll/reconcileMonth)
nodes.rationale: Pending local changes win, otherwise Calendar wins; all API calls serialized through enqueue() promise chain.

nodes.label: Firebase Real-time Mode (Firestore source of truth)
nodes.norm_label: firebase real-time mode (firestore source of truth)
nodes.rationale: Optional; Firestore users/{uid}/days|log|hidden is source of truth with onSnapshot listeners; Calendar becomes a mirror.

nodes.label: History Spreadsheet 'Office Tracker · Historial' (syncSheet/pullSheet)
nodes.rationale: Append-only audit log shared across devices; column W holds JSON for exact read-back; Ocultos tab shares deletions.

nodes.norm_label: firestore data model (users/{uid}/days, log, hidden, meta)

nodes.label: Phase A: Firestore Instant Sync (implemented v13)
nodes.norm_label: phase a: firestore instant sync (implemented v13)
nodes.rationale: Spark plan (free); instant cross-device sync with app open, offline support, session not expiring hourly.

nodes.label: Phase B: Push Notifications with App Closed (FCM + Cloud Functions)
nodes.norm_label: phase b: push notifications with app closed (fcm + cloud functions)
nodes.rationale: Requires Blaze plan; push on day change to other devices and 9:00 daily mandatory-day alert.

nodes.label: Phase C: Calendar Webhook (calendarWebhook, renewWatch, oauthCallback)
nodes.norm_label: phase c: calendar webhook (calendarwebhook, renewwatch, oauthcallback)
nodes.rationale: Calendar push needs HTTPS server webhook and offline refresh token (client secret in Secret Manager); channels expire and must be renewed.

nodes.label: Goal Alert Levels (Vas bien / Poco margen / Sí o sí / No alcanzas)
nodes.norm_label: goal alert levels (vas bien / poco margen / si o si / no alcanzas)

nodes.label: Google Cloud Setup (APIs, consent screen, Client ID)
nodes.norm_label: google cloud setup (apis, consent screen, client id)
nodes.rationale: Client-only app: only the Client ID is used, never the client secret; testing mode requires adding test users.

nodes.label: Sync and Version Indicators (topbar, chip, step label)
nodes.norm_label: sync and version indicators (topbar, chip, step label)

nodes.label: Change Detection Polling (checkChanges every 10s, calCursor)
nodes.rationale: Lightweight checks (Calendar updatedMin, Drive modifiedTime) trigger full syncAll only on change; 60s Calendar-only when Firebase on.

nodes.label: Change Flow with 5s Undo Window (applyChange/schedulePush)
nodes.rationale: Push waits UNDO_MS for the undo toast; flushPushes pushes immediately when page is hidden.

nodes.label: Minimal OAuth Scopes (calendar.app.created, calendarlist.readonly, drive.file)
nodes.rationale: calendarlist.readonly needed because calendarList.list rejects app.created alone; calendar.events only for cleanupLegacy.

nodes.label: Monthly Quota Logic (stats)
nodes.rationale: Base 8 visits/month; weeks with holiday/vacation have quota 1, target = 8 - adjusted weeks; straddling weeks count only days in visible month.

nodes.label: One Office Tracker Calendar per Account (ensureCalendar/mergeCalendar)
nodes.norm_label: one office tracker calendar per account (ensurecalendar/mergecalendar)
nodes.rationale: Lowest id wins, duplicates merged and deleted; never create a calendar if lookup failed, avoiding duplicates across devices.

nodes.label: Day Tombstones, Newest ts Wins (reconcileMonthFS)
nodes.rationale: Day docs never deleted (type:null); Calendar event imported only when its updated is newer than Firestore ts.

nodes.label: Do Not Change TYPE_LBL (emoji parsed by classify())
nodes.norm_label: do not change type_lbl (emoji parsed by classify())
nodes.rationale: Emoji become Calendar event titles that classify() parses back into day types.

nodes.label: API Key Website Restriction (incl. authDomain)
nodes.rationale: authDomain firebaseapp.com must be allowed since the sign-in popup opens from it.

nodes.label: Firestore Security Rules (users/{uid} owner-only)
nodes.rationale: Firebase apiKey is not secret; rules protect data. Never allow read, write: if true.

nodes.label: Safe Migration (wait for server before upload)
nodes.norm_label: safe migration (wait for server before upload)
nodes.rationale: New device waits for first real server response and uploads only days Firestore lacks, never overwriting newer data.

nodes.label: Google Session ~1 Hour Expiry (Reconectar)
nodes.rationale: Google limit for serverless apps; changes stay local and upload after reconnect. Firebase session does not expire hourly.

nodes.label: Google Sheet history audit log
nodes.community_name: APIs de Google y hoja del log
nodes.rationale: Historial tab is an append-only audit log; deleted entries are hidden via an Ocultos tab rather than removed, and a deleted sheet is recreated automatically.

nodes.label: Lightweight change polling
nodes.community_name: APIs de Google y hoja del log
nodes.rationale: Polls Calendar updatedMin (10s, or 60s with Firebase) and Drive modifiedTime; triggers full syncAll only when something changed, plus 5-minute fallback full sync.

nodes.label: MOVIMIENTO Motion Section (anim, reduced-motion, transform/opacity only)
nodes.norm_label: movimiento motion section (anim, reduced-motion, transform/opacity only)

nodes.label: App state object S (data, evIds, pending, log, hidden)
nodes.norm_label: app state object s (data, evids, pending, log, hidden)
nodes.rationale: Single in-memory store persisted to localStorage by save()/load(); shared by all sync paths.

nodes.label: First-server-snapshot migration
nodes.rationale: Uploading local data missing in Firestore waits for the first non-cache snapshot so an empty cache on a new device does not overwrite newer data.

nodes.label: Monthly office attendance goal / mandatory days
nodes.norm_label: monthly office attendance goal / mandatory days

nodes.label: Reminder deep link with nonce verification
nodes.norm_label: reminder deep link with nonce verification
nodes.rationale: Calendar reminder events at 10:00 and 16:30 contain a link ?d=&r=&n=; the nonce is verified when opening the notification sheet.

nodes.label: Firestore as source of truth (realtime mode)
nodes.norm_label: firestore as source of truth (realtime mode)
nodes.rationale: With Firebase on, Firestore wins for days/history; Google Calendar becomes a copy, except events edited in Calendar after the last Firestore change are imported.

nodes.label: Pending-wins month reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Without Firebase: local pending changes win; otherwise Calendar wins (create/move/rename/delete from Calendar app); duplicate events per day collapse to one.

nodes.label: Colombian Holidays Computation (holidays(y), Ley Emiliani, Easter)
nodes.norm_label: colombian holidays computation (holidays(y), ley emiliani, easter)

nodes.norm_label: github pages deployment and android install

nodes.label: Global State Object S
nodes.rationale: Single global object holds data, evIds, pending, log, reminders, legacy; persisted to localStorage ot-data-v2 schema v:3 with migration of older shapes.

nodes.label: Bump VERSION (sw.js) and APP_VER (index.html) together
nodes.rationale: Old caches must be dropped on publish; HTML network-first, icons/manifest cache-first, Google origins bypass SW.

nodes.label: Serial Calendar job queue
nodes.rationale: All Calendar/Sheet work runs one at a time on a promise chain; S.busy feeds the sync indicator.

nodes.label: Undo window before push
nodes.rationale: Changes are pushed only after UNDO_MS; pushDay skips days still in the undo timer.
